verdict.rationale: Cake documents digital issuance and management of share certificates. It offers holdings and transactional certificate types, and transactional certificates imply a per-issuance tie to cap table records. Previously issued certificates can also be uploaded and linked so shareholders see them in their portal. However, in-platform legal signing is only documented for option board sign-offs and SAFE/note workflows, not for share certificates themselves. Missing for 10: evidence that certificates are legally e-signed in-platform, explicit documentation that each issued certificate is permanently linked to its cap table entry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
